desc:
This move makes it harder for White to take sente. If White answers this, Black intends to tenuki and allow White to block off the right side area.

See [Michael Redmond's Go TV, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 7, Qiao Zhijian 4p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YJDCyB6qDws&t=262s)
